construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored within this isolated build directory.

input.fixture: Exact object: kind='synthetic', id='synthetic-' plus nonempty suffix, maximum 100 characters.
input.goals: Nonempty unique array: launch_store and/or improve_sales.
input.completed_steps: Unique known step IDs with all experience-specific prerequisites completed.

output.data: On success: schema_version, fixture, experience, preferences, goals, steps, next_actions, progress, onboarding_complete, adaptation_explanation. Null on error.
output.errors: Empty on success; otherwise array of field/message objects.
output.step: id, title, state (complete|ready|blocked), prerequisites, blocked_by, serves_goals, explanation, guidance, guidance_level
output.progress: completed and total count required steps only; percent rounded to two decimals.

shared_schema.validation: One validate_input boundary shared by direct calls and CLI. Unknown/missing keys, unsupported values, duplicate selections and inconsistent completion are rejected. CLI additionally rejects invalid files, encodings, malformed JSON, non-finite JSON constants and duplicate object keys.
shared_schema.error_contract: CLI prints exactly one JSON object; success exits 0, validation/file errors exit 2. response(payload) returns the same envelope; onboarding(payload) raises ValidationError for invalid input.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality only: validated input -> experience-specific prerequisite closure -> topologically ordered guided plan -> shared response envelope.

behavior.goals: launch_store ends at publish; improve_sales adds analytics and optimization. Multiple goals share steps without duplication.
behavior.adaptation: Novices require orientation and guided explanations. Intermediate users receive standard explanations, experts concise guidance. All users retain operational prerequisites.
behavior.preferences: Practice adds synthetic exercises; explanation adds rationale review. Focused pace recommends one ready action; batch recommends at most three.
behavior.progression: Re-run with updated completed_steps; ready recommendations never include blocked or completed steps. All-required-complete produces an empty next_actions array.
behavior.determinism: Fixed catalog order, sorted goals and reasons, no random values, timestamps, external services or input mutation.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: example_input.json is a fictional new seller; no real customer information or real marketplace activity.

included: Synthetic fixtures and standard-library unittest coverage
excluded: Persistence, accounts, authentication and user interface
Real checkout, listing publication or sales analysis
Network calls and model providers; no LLM step is needed
Enterprise production operation and arbitrary user-defined prerequisite graphs

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: exactly one JSON object with status ok, exit code 0.
test_outcomes.coverage: Normal novice/intermediate/expert plans; preference and pace adaptation; prerequisites; partial/full completion; goal order and topological order; deterministic nonmutation; invalid schema; CLI success, usage, missing files, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite constants and invalid encoding.
